Frequently Asked Questions

How do I book tutoring?

Use the Book a Session form. Mr. Kamulegeya confirms the time and format with you.

Can I pay online?

Not yet. Payment is arranged directly once an order or session is confirmed.

Is my request sent automatically?

Requests open in WhatsApp or email when a verified contact is configured. Otherwise you can copy the summary and send it yourself.

How do I order a book?

Use the Order Books form and submit the request.

Can schools get in touch?

Yes, use the form on the Schools page.

Mr. Kamulegeya Mubarak Kiggundu — mathematics educator and author.
